description: Registered fault/crash hooks in LiteDB/ and the evidence that claims each one. Maintained by .github/scripts/check_fault_points.py; see docs/rules/safety-evidence.md.

models.exception: An API or I/O operation fails and unwinding/cleanup runs.
models.process-death: The process or owner dies without graceful disposal; OS cache and surviving processes remain.
models.modeled-power-loss: A fault-model stream/device keeps only durable bytes (lost, torn or reordered unsynced writes).
models.device: An actual OS/VM reset or physical-device campaign.
models.corrupt-input: Damaged or unsupported persisted input must be detected without silent acceptance.
models.interleaving: The hook pauses or orders work to force a concurrent interleaving; not a failure by itself.
models.capability: The hook simulates a platform capability (for example unsupported sync), not a failure.

hooks.name: transaction-before-completion-cleanup

evidence.proves: A grouped or callback-fallback writer is held after snapshot disposal and before map cleanup; final close reaches transaction cleanup after WAL drain but cannot retire services until completion exits. Close succeeds, acknowledgement is refused and repeated indexed recovery plus raw allocation reachability preserves whole outcomes.

hooks.gap: Default-off path, deterministic xUnit scheduling only. These observers do not establish active-worker process-death or modeled-power-loss coverage.

observers.AtCrashPoint: Per-engine delivery of the process-crash family's named points (CrashPoint also calls SimulateProcessCrash); each name is registered under hooks with its own evidence, so this delegate adds no boundary of its own.
observers.BeforeCreatePipe: Interleaving hook before the coordinator creates its pipe; no persistent state changes at this point.
observers.BeforePageRead: Observes page reads (position, origin) to force read interleavings; faults use SimulateDiskReadFail.
observers.BeforeReadLength: Interleaving hook before a file length is read; no persistent state changes.
observers.BeforeWaitOutHeartbeats: Interleaving hook in coordinator status-page heartbeats; in-memory coordination only.
observers.CoreStage: Ownership observer: reports the opened/closing/closed lifecycle of each Shared core that requires writer exclusion; it never injects a fault.
observers.CoordinationStage: Observes in-process Shared admission stages (opening, lease-published, admitted, expiring); lease-file persistence is listed under unhookedTransitions.
observers.FinalizedInUse: Detects page buffers finalized while in use (leak diagnostics), not a fault boundary.
observers.HandshakeStage: Observes coordinator handshake stages to force interleavings; no persistent state changes.
observers.LevelRandomFactory: Makes vector index level selection deterministic for tests; not a fault boundary.
observers.ObserveCacheEviction: Measurement hook proving cache eviction happened; not a fault boundary.
observers.Observer: Reachability observer: runs on the thread that hit a marker (for example a fault-point site) so a fuzz oracle can evaluate an invariant there; it never injects a fault.
observers.ObserveSortSpill: Measurement hook proving a sort spilled to disk; not a fault boundary.
observers.Releasing: Ownership observer: runs just before a Shared connection releases its native writer mutex so an oracle can check every protected core finished teardown; it never injects a fault.
observers.SnapshotCaptured: Interleaving hook after checkpoint captures its snapshot; checkpoint persistence is covered by checkpoint-stage and process-crash hooks.
observers.BeforeFinalClose: Pauses the last Direct facade close before engine disposal; DirectProcessHost_Tests.Open_during_last_close_waits_then_opens_fresh forces the open/close interleaving.
observers.UnsupportedVolume: Overrides native volume qualification for fail-closed admission capability testing; no fallback is enabled.

unhookedTransitions.transition: Directory-entry persistence of the recovery marker and the backup/install renames: rebuild-install hooks fault the operations, but the model does not lose unsynced directory entries.
Reader lease-file publication, renewal and expiry have observer stages only (CoordinationStage); no registered fault point interrupts them.
